COURSE INFORMATION

Following professionals can go to this course:

Beneficiaries

Students wishing to learn to use Salesforce services are expected to know about the working of Cloud. Cloud Architecture, types of Clouds, the differences between the various types of clouds. Essentially all that is to learn about Cloud.

Hands-on experience

Online IT Guru is a firm that has prior experience working with Salesforce. We employ well equipped and experienced faculty to train and teach students all about Salesforce. The faculty is always ready to imbibe all the knowledge acquired by them by spending years in the industry working with Salesforce services and products. The faculty gives the students practical assignments at a regular basis that are designed on par with the real world situations and problems. This approach prepares the students and makes them industry ready.
